description: Extended false-alarm evaluation on new real-world normal-riding data (potholes + speed bumps only -- see module docstring for why hard-braking/aggressive-acceleration/sharp-turns coverage could not be added from this particular source), evaluated with the already-deployed model (no retraining).
source_citation: Khandakar, A., Michelson, D. G., Naznine, M., Salam, A., Nahiduzzaman, Md., Khan, K., Suganthan, P. N., Ayari, M. A., Menouar, H., & Haider, J. (2024). STRIDE (Sensor Technologies for Road Insights and Driving Evaluation) Dataset [Data set]. Figshare. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.25460755 (CC BY 4.0, verified via the Figshare API).
vehicle_caveat: Recorded on a car, not a motorcycle -- evaluation-only, not used for training.
